Use case: sketch-to-render. Create a premium hand-painted 2D SIDE-VIEW side-scrolling game environment, wide 8:3 canvas 1728x648. IMAGE 1 is an exact geometry blueprint already positioned on the desired full canvas. IMAGE 2 is ART STYLE ONLY, not layout. Render the GREEN terrain and BEIGE horizontal platforms from image1 into mossy stone, natural cliffs, ancient masonry and a little timber bracing. Preserve every top-surface x and y, width, step, overhang and gap of IMAGE1 extremely carefully. Its empty upper band is additional sky/canopy space, not a border. Full-bleed scene with no margin.
Level01: dawn fern grove with softly lit deep turquoise distant cedar forest and a broken circular aqueduct in the distance. In full 1728x648 coordinates: low left ground x0-364 top540; open pit x364-556; slim pier x556-648 from y414 to bottom; continuous beige fixed shelf x423-1047 y382-413; small green step x648-744 top310; high beige shelf x888-1203 y228-266; irregular right massif shaped exactly like guide, main vertical x1122-1203 from y270 to bottom, upper extension x1203-1287 y312-414, left overhang x1047-1122 y414-478; low basin floor x1203-1497 top597; exit bank x1497-right top447; short fixed shelf x1353-1497 y447. Keep all these visible shapes separate/readable. An empty modest stone arch sits on the exit bank at the yellow outline, WITHOUT door or magical effect. No other foreground flat ledges. Give the beige slabs narrow root/wood supports only where they won't fill pits or change paths.
Artwork style exactly image2: rich detailed painted vegetation, moss-covered chipped stone, sharp readable sunlit grassy edges, lush layered woodland, 2D illustration, NOT 3D, NOT isometric, no pixel art. Soft warm gold and deep emerald/teal. Add sparse corner leaves above the route, keep surfaces readable. Dry distant rock channel near x820 y300-540 reserved for a later animated waterfall; DO NOT paint any water/waterfall into this static master. No floating particles, mist effects or large moving vines. No characters, blocks, levers, elevators, plates, reflectors, ropes, spikes, numbers, letters, grid, arrows, legend, labels, door, magical seal, UI. Blue negative spaces in guide become atmospheric distant scenery but never new foreground walkable terrain. Preserve the precise reference arrangement, do not beautify by redesigning.

Preserve canvas 2048x768, framing, all object positions and sizes exactly. Keep ALL sunlit grassy platforms, ground, stone columns, cliffs, timber braces, right empty stone arch, moss/ferns attached to them, and ONLY the near corner framing tree branches/leaves. Remove ALL distant blue/teal forest, sky, distant ruins/aqueduct, distant mountains and haze, leaving genuine alpha in every gap, pit, below floating bridges, and inside the empty exit arch. Transparent PNG cutout at the same very wide 8:3 ratio, no contact sheet, no shadow backdrop.

Keep the same 2048x768 wide canvas and distant forest/canopy, sky, mountains, turquoise atmosphere and distant aqueduct placement and brushwork. No horizontal foreground walkable ground, no readable platforms anywhere. DRY scenery: no waterfall or water streams, no mist sprite effects, no floating particles, no hanging foreground vines. No UI, grid, text, characters or mechanisms. This is inpainting the same scene, not a new composition.
